note: Hand fixes for 7014 Navidad Rd. Coordinates are Matterport plan coordinates (x, y), not house-local.

splits.why: Matterport classifies the whole 46 m2 open area as 'Kitchen'. The top-down render shows the vaulted living room (fireplace, wood floor) north of the counter half-wall at y = 2.0.
South of the half-wall: the tiled kitchen (cabinets, sink) is east of x = 1.0, the wood-floored dining area by the windows is west of it.

drop_boxes.why: Bathroom r11: the scan bulges 0.34 m out of the wall where the big mirror above the sink is (mirrors confuse the depth camera), and the fitted box stood in front of the mirror like a pillar. Plan coordinates (x, y, z); any fitted box that contains the point is dropped.

remove.why: Garage r6: a rubbish bin and its lid were left by the wall next to the garage door when the house was scanned. It is clutter, not part of the house, and scans as a crumpled shell. Plan coordinates (x, y, z); scan pieces within `radius` (horizontal) of the point are removed and the wall and floor behind are filled in.
